title: Machine learning prediction of atrial fibrillation in cardiovascular patients using cardiac magnetic resonance and electronic health information.
summary: Prospective CIROC cohort supplied 9,448 patients, 7,639 for model development; nested five-fold validation of random-survival-forest models gave mean C-index 0.78 and time-dependent AUC about 0.80/0.80/0.78. Full-text Methods and Results were checked; the AI operation, first result-bearing version, measured result and validation are confirmed, with no catalog or lane duplicate.
ai_technology: Random-survival-forest models analyze prospective cardiovascular cohort data to predict incident atrial fibrillation.
